# LabeledLine

Qualified name: `manim.mobject.geometry.labeled.LabeledLine`

class LabeledLine(*label*, *label\_position=0.5*, *label\_config=None*, *box\_config=None*, *frame\_config=None*, *\*args*, *\*\*kwargs*)
:   Bases: [`Line`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.geometry.line.Line.html#manim.mobject.geometry.line.Line "manim.mobject.geometry.line.Line")

    Constructs a line containing a label box somewhere along its length.

    Parameters:
    :   - **label** (*str* *|* [*ManimTextLabel*](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.typing.html#manim.typing.ManimTextLabel "manim.typing.ManimTextLabel")) – Label that will be displayed on the line.
        - **label\_position** (*float*) – A ratio in the range [0-1] to indicate the position of the label with respect to the length of the line. Default value is 0.5.
        - **label\_config** (*dict**[**str**,* *Any**]* *|* *None*) – A dictionary containing the configuration for the label.
          This is only applied if `label` is of type `str`.
        - **box\_config** (*dict**[**str**,* *Any**]* *|* *None*) – A dictionary containing the configuration for the background box.
        - **frame\_config** (*dict**[**str**,* *Any**]* *|* *None*) –

          A dictionary containing the configuration for the frame.

          See also

          [`LabeledArrow`](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/reference/manim.mobject.geometry.labeled.LabeledArrow.html#manim.mobject.geometry.labeled.LabeledArrow "manim.mobject.geometry.labeled.LabeledArrow")
        - **args** (*Any*)
        - **kwargs** (*Any*)

    Examples

    Example: LabeledLineExample

    ![../_images/LabeledLineExample-1.png](https://docs.manim.community/en/v0.22.1/_images/LabeledLineExample-1.png)

    ```
    from manim import *

    class LabeledLineExample(Scene):
        def construct(self):
            line = LabeledLine(
                label          = '0.5',
                label_position = 0.8,
                label_config = {
                    "font_size" : 20
                },
                start=LEFT+DOWN,
                end=RIGHT+UP)

            line.set_length(line.get_length() * 2)
            self.add(line)
    ```
